title: Ship It?
instruction: Each tap adds one day of data (500 users per variant). Ship B, keep A, or wait. The plan said 14 days.

rounds.label: A freshness boost for new arrivals

debrief: Watching a moving p-value and stopping the moment it dips under 0.05 ships noise. Fix the sample size first, wait for it, and check that the effect outlasts the novelty.
